projects.name: Qaza Namaz Tracker
projects.shortDesc: Qaza Namaz Tracker is a simple and organized tool designed to help you keep track of your Qaza Namaz. You can record your own Qaza prayers, track completed prayers, and maintain a record for Marhoomeen. The platform also includes a Family Contribution feature, allowing family members to contribute and keep the record organized together. It is designed to work smoothly on both mobile phones and computers.
projects.fullDesc:
# Qaza Namaz Tracker

**Qaza Namaz Tracker** 
ek simple aur organized web application hai jo Qaza Namazon ka record maintain aur track karne mein madad karta hai. Iska maqsad ek aisa easy-to-use platform provide karna hai jahan aap apni Qaza Namazon ka record systematically manage kar saken.

## 🕌 Apni Qaza Namazon Ka Record

Aap apni Qaza Namazon ka record add kar sakte hain aur jo Qaza Namaz ada kar chuke hain unhein tracker mein mark karke apni progress dekh sakte hain. Is se aapko apne record ko organized rakhne mein aasani hoti hai.

## 🤲 Marhoomeen Ki Qaza Namaz

Qaza Namaz Tracker mein **Marhoomeen** ke liye bhi alag record maintain karne ka option diya gaya hai. Aap kisi marhoom family member ke liye Qaza Namazon ka record create karke ada ki jane wali Qaza Namazon ko track kar sakte hain.

## 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Contribution

Is project ka ek important feature **Family Contribution** hai. Family ke multiple members mil kar kisi selected family member ki Qaza Namazon ke record mein apna contribution add kar sakte hain.

Is tarah family members ke contributions ko ek organized record ki form mein maintain karna aasaan ho jata hai.

## 📊 Progress Tracking

Tracker aapko completed Qaza Namazon aur remaining record ko samajhne mein madad karta hai. Aap apni progress ko dekh sakte hain aur apne record ko regularly update kar sakte hain.

## ☁️ Family Record

Family ke selected record ko organize karne ke liye **Google Drive** based setup ka option bhi use kiya ja sakta hai, jis se family contribution ka data ek jagah manage karne mein madad milti hai.

## 📱 Mobile & Computer Friendly

Qaza Namaz Tracker ko **responsive design** ke saath banaya gaya hai, is liye ise mobile phone, tablet aur computer par use kiya ja sakta hai.

## ✨ Main Features

- Apni Qaza Namazon ka record
- Completed Qaza Namazon ki tracking
- Remaining Qaza Namazon ka record
- Marhoomeen ke liye Qaza Namaz tracking
- Family Contribution feature
- Family members ke contributions ka record
- Organized progress tracking
- Google Drive based family record setup
- Mobile-friendly interface
- Computer-friendly interface
- Simple aur easy-to-use design

### 🌙 Hamara Maqsad

Qaza Namaz Tracker ka maqsad Qaza Namazon ke record ko **simple, organized aur easily manageable** banana hai, taake users apni aur family ke Qaza Namaz records ko behtar tareeqe se maintain kar saken.

**Qaza Namaz Tracker — Apni Qaza Namaz ka record rakhein, progress track karein, aur family ke saath contribution ko organize karein.**

> **Note:** Ye application sirf record keeping aur tracking ke liye ek digital tool hai. Qaza Namaz se related fiqhi/shar'i masail ke liye apne trusted scholar ya qualified Islamic authority se rehnumai hasil karein.
projects.requirements: Any Modern Browser, No Installation Required
